title: A Design Space for Data Agents: Insights from KDD Cup 2026
abstract: arXiv:2611.28970v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data agents interpret analytical requests, gather evidence from heterogeneous sources, and compute results within finite resource budgets. We analyze the final code submissions of the ten highest-ranked teams in the KDD Cup 2026 Data Agents for Complex Data Analysis competition. We organize the observed design choices into three interacting layers, covering workflow orchestration, analytical functions, and working state. The comparison reveals recurring patterns for allocating computation in response to task progress, structuring evidence for computation and assessment, and preserving reusable artifacts with their provenance. Candidates that rely on the same evidence can inherit the same error, so interpreting their agreement requires tracing those dependencies. The design space motivates controlled evaluations of how resource allocation, evidence sharing, and targeted recovery affect task completion and correctness.

translated_title: 数据智能体的设计空间：来自 KDD Cup 2026 的洞见
translated_abstract: 数据智能体能够解析分析请求、从异构数据源中收集证据，并在有限的资源预算内计算结果。我们分析了 KDD Cup 2026“面向复杂数据分析的数据智能体”竞赛中排名前十队伍的最终代码提交，将观察到的设计选择归纳为三个相互作用的层次，涵盖工作流编排、分析功能和工作状态。这一比较揭示了若干反复出现的设计模式：如何根据任务进展分配计算资源、如何为计算和评估构建证据结构，以及如何保存可复用的产物及其溯源信息。依赖相同证据的候选结果可能继承相同的错误，因此解读它们之间的一致性需要追溯这些依赖关系。该设计空间为进一步开展受控评估奠定了基础，可用于研究资源分配、证据共享和针对性恢复如何影响任务完成度与正确性。
tldr: 该论文通过分析 KDD Cup 2026 数据智能体竞赛十强队伍的代码提交，提出了一个由工作流编排、分析功能和工作状态三层构成的数据智能体设计空间，揭示了资源分配、证据结构化与可复用产物保存等关键设计模式，并指出候选结果间的一致性需通过追溯证据依赖来解读。
en_tdlr: By analyzing the final code submissions of the ten highest-ranked teams in the KDD Cup 2026 Data Agents competition, this paper proposes a three-layer design space for data agents covering workflow orchestration, analytical functions, and working state, revealing recurring patterns in computation allocation, evidence structuring, and reusable artifact preservation.
